issues.observation: New VDD contour-derived curve reduced earlier protruding crop, but selected side profile frames (40,43) still show an unnatural abrupt face-to-hair edge and narrow face.
issues.rootCauseHypothesis: Mask is now spatially continuous but remains a straight X wipe, independent of the authored face/hair contour correspondences.
issues.requiredFix: Author and register an INNER hair/skin seam (front/right/rear/left) with forehead, temple, cheek, jaw and chin control point correspondences. Drive both face occlusion and front/back hair coverage from that seam. An outer face silhouette alone is insufficient.

issues.observation: Frame 132 has less of the old rectangular forehead protrusion, but facial reveal still has a near-vertical slice and unregistered fringe/hair intersection.
issues.rootCauseHypothesis: Generic profile geometry and a single straight clipping plane do not encode facial contour/head volume as 270°→360° interpolates.
issues.requiredFix: Supply separate face/hair inner-outline control points and dynamically triangulate or compute an SDF for the actual hairline; compare local face/behind-hair masks at each head yaw. Do not substitute uniform alpha or temporal smoothness.

issues.observation: Side arm joints and forearm shape have obvious rigid/paper cutout appearance. Passing IK endpoint and selected overlap rules does not validate silhouette under reaching/rotation.
issues.requiredFix: Use 3D joint direction to drive a pose-aware arm profile/mesh corrective and test hand/forearm visible shape at 45/90/135/225/270.

issues.observation: Only foot height was checked. Rotating leg/foot motion can slide in world XY; full planting cannot be claimed.
issues.requiredFix: Add world-space planted foot targets and two-bone leg IK, with per-frame foot velocity/ground contact traces.

stageDecision: BLOCK FINAL DYNAMIC 360 ACCEPTANCE. New curved proxy and 11/11 gates PASS; hairline seam still FAIL_VISUAL.
